description: Prepare one custom audience (customer list, website pixel, app or offline) or one lookalike in a client's Meta account. Changes nothing: returns a preview_id (15 min, one use) for execute_prepared_change.

country.description: For lookalike: country code, e.g. PL.

name.description: Audience name in the Meta account.

ratio.description: For lookalike: size 0.01-0.20 (1-20% of the country).

retention_days.description: For WEBSITE: days a visitor stays in the audience.

source_audience_id.description: For lookalike: Meta id of the source custom audience.

subtype.description: For custom: CUSTOM, WEBSITE, APP or OFFLINE_CONVERSION.

name: prepare_meta_audience_create
